intro.text: A former country estate in the Southern Dominance that became the seat of King Audil Lekal after the Lord Ruler's death.

description.text: Before the Lord Ruler died it was a country estate with a manor house but no true palace, though it was notable enough to appear on maps from 1021.

items.text: After the Lord Ruler's death a shantytown grew up around the main manor house.
King Audil Lekal ruled his kingdom from Lekal City.

Sazed and Breeze came to Lekal City as ambassadors of Elend Venture's New Empire to seek Audil Lekal's surrender. Seeing he was beaten, the king signed a treaty making his kingdom a vassal of the empire.
Lava from a nearby ashmount destroyed Lekal City, and the whole Southern Dominance was said to be burning.
